title: Humans and aliens working side by side at Mount Zeal

tellings.quote: And I've heard that from people who absolutely know for sure. Yeah.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, says on a podcast that at Mount Zeil, a mountain in Australia, humans and aliens work side by side. He says he heard this from people who "absolutely know for sure," though he does not say when. If true, it would mean an open working partnership with non-human beings hidden in a remote place.
